{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes, especially when sentiment is neutral or negative.",
    "Adjust downward bias in forecasts when sentiment history shows increasing negative sentiment (e.g., >0.50 or -0.25 trend).",
    "Apply mean reversion correction: if forecast is >10% above recent 5-day average, reduce by 5-10% unless sentiment supports continuation.",
    "Increase downward bias in forecasts when sentiment is consistently negative (e.g., multiple -0.25 or 0.00 entries), especially in early horizon (1-3 days).",
    "Avoid overreacting to recent highs: if model forecast is >15% above true outcome 3-5 days prior, reduce forecast by 5-10% for next period.",
    "When sentiment is positive (e.g., 0.50 or above), allow slight upward bias but cap at +5% above recent 7-day average to avoid overcorrection.",
    "If true outcome is consistently below forecast (e.g., 3 consecutive days), apply downward adjustment of 2-5% for next forecast horizon.",
    "For 30-day forecasts, reduce volatility by smoothing out extreme outliers (e.g., >15% deviation from 15-day moving average)."
  ]
}
